description: This file declares an interface class IEventHandler within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The interface defines several pure virtual methods for handling different events, including runtime manager, window manager, ripple, and state change events, each accepting relevant parameters. The file also includes licensing information and include directives for string and JSON handling.

classes.name: IEventHandler
